verdict.rationale:
Rootly ships multiple in-product AI features that generate insights/suggestions directly from incident data: AI Summaries auto-drafted from metadata/timeline/Slack/transcripts, Ask Rootly AI chat grounded in live incident context, AI blocks in retrospectives, Related Incidents matching via TF-IDF, and AI SRE that investigates alerts and proposes diagnoses using connectors like AWS/Atlassian. These are well documented across many first-party doc pages and cover summarization, Q&A, root-cause suggestions, and cross-incident pattern insight generation natively inside the product.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of AI output quality or accuracy, and any user reviews specifically praising/critiquing these AI insight features.
